_real_world.class: Bow-mounted active/passive hull sonar (bulbous-bow hull), designation varies by class (SJD-9 reported for Type 052D)
_real_world.variant_scope: Type 055, Type 052D/052DL, Type 054A, Type 054B bow sonar fit; shared module since no per-class detection-range figures exist.
public_equipment: SJD-9 hull-mounted sonar (Type 052D, per Naval News)

_provenance.modeling_note: Shared bow hull-sonar module for all four PLAN escort classes in this packet. The OOB confirms a bulbous-bow hull sonar fit for Type 055 (B-tier), SJD-9 for Type 052D (B-tier, Naval News), and an unspecified hull sonar for Type 054A/054B (all hulls per USNI); none carries a public detection-range or sensitivity figure. Modeled as an active/passive hull sonar following the repo's SQS-53C CSG module pattern, since no PLAN-specific active/passive detail exists to differentiate the four classes.

sonar.mode.note: no PLAN source distinguishes active vs passive-only capability for any of these 4 classes' bow sonars; Active is modeled per the repo's SQS-53C CSG module convention for a modern bow-mounted hull sonar, since none of these classes is described as passive-only
